description: In crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs, BackendCallFn is typed as dyn Fn(Arc<B>, String, serde_json::Value) -> HandlerFuture. In ClosureHandler::call the second String argument passed to call_fn is call_id (line 279: (self.call_fn)(Arc::clone(&self.backend), call_id, args)). The doc comment on JmapHandler::call explains that method is passed as the first String and call_id as the second, but ClosureHandler silently drops method entirely and forwards call_id in what appears to be the method position. Any BackendCallFn closure that inspects its second String argument expecting a method name receives call_id instead. The doc comment on ClosureHandler says it ignores call_id but the signature passes it to the closure. This was present before round 1 but was made more prominent by the new ClosureHandler doc comment added in round 1 which describes the CallerCtx limitation without mentioning the method/call_id swap. P3 doc/API confusion risk.
title: ClosureHandler passes call_id instead of method to BackendCallFn
